Meeting with President of China and President of the United States

A trilateral meeting between President of Russia Vladimir Putin, President of China Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump took place on the sidelines of the APEC Summit in Shenzhen.

November 19, 2026
11:30
Shenzhen

At the end of the meeting, the Russia-China-US Heads of State Declaration toward Peace was adopted.

* * *

Taking part in the trilateral meeting on the Russian side were Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov Lavrov SergeiMinister of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation , Deputy Prime Minister – Finance Minister Anton Siluanov Siluanov AntonDeputy Prime Minister of the Government of the Russian Federation – Minister of Finance of the Russian Federation , Deputy Chief of Staff of the Presidential Executive Office Maxim Oreshkin Oreshkin MaximDeputy Chief of Staff of the Presidential Executive Office , Presidential Aide Yury Ushakov Ushakov YuryAide to the President , and Defence Minister Andrei Belousov Belousov AndreiDefence Minister of the Russian Federation .
